en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Hamza Al Hashimy, from Ali Bin Muhammad or Muhammad Bin Ali Al Hashimy who said,

‘I went over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> on the morning of his<sup>asws</sup> marriage when he<sup>asws</sup> married the daughter of Al-Mamoun, and I had taken medicine the night before. So the first one to go over to him in the morning was me, and the thirst had hit me, and I disliked to call for the water. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) looked at me in my face and said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> think you are thirsty. So I said, ‘Yes’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O boy! or ‘O Maid! Quench us with the water’.

So I said within myself, ‘At this time he would come with the water having been poisoned with’, and I was gloomy due to that. So the boy came and with him was the water, and he<sup>asws</sup> smiled in my face, then said: ‘O boy! Give me<sup>asws</sup> the water!’. So he gave him<sup>asws</sup> the water, and he<sup>asws</sup> drank’. Then he gave it to me, so I drank. Then I was thirsty as well, and I disliked to call for the water. So he<sup>asws</sup> did what he<sup>asws</sup> had done formerly. So when the boy came and with him was the cup, I said within myself the like of what I had said during the first (time). So he<sup>asws</sup> took the cup and drank, then he<sup>asws</sup> gave it to me and smiled’.
Muhammad Bin Hamza said, ‘So this Hashimy said to me, ‘And I think he<sup>asws</sup> is just as they (Shias) are saying’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn Hamza al-Hashimi from Ali ibn Muhammad or Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hashimi who has said the following “

I went tot see abu Ja‘far (a.s.) in the morning of his marriage to the daughter of al-Ma’al-Ma’mun. The night before I had taken medicine and I was the first to meet him that morning. I was thirsty but did not like to ask for water. Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) looked at me and said, “I think you are thirsty.” I said, “Yes, I am thirsty.” He called, “O Ghulam (male slave or servant) or Jariya (female slave orservant) bring us water.”

I said to myself, “They may poison the water. For this reason I became depressed. The servant then came with water. He (abu Ja‘far (a.s.) looked at me with a smile and, “O Ghulam, give the water.” He drank from it and gave the rest to me and I drank. I became thirsty again and did not like to ask for water. He then did as he had done before. When the Ghulam (servant) came with the bowl of water I thought as I thought before. He then took the bowl, drank from it and gave the rest to me with a smile.”
Muhammad ibn Hamza has said that this Hashimi told me, “I think what they (Shi‘a ) say (that Imams possess Divine Authority) about him is true.”
